mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.symbol, t.market_currency AS marketCurrency, t.last_price AS lastPrice, t.bid_price AS bidPrice, t.ask_price AS askPrice, t.traded_at AS tradedAt, t.received_at AS receivedAt FROM pilot_market_ticks t INNER JOIN ( SELECT symbol, MAX(id) AS id FROM pilot_market_ticks GROUP BY symbol ) latest ON latest.id = t.id ORDER BY t.symbol

SELECT id, symbol, market_currency AS marketCurrency, quantity, invested_amount AS investedAmount, average_entry_price AS averageEntryPrice, status, opened_at AS openedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, closed_at AS closedAt FROM pilot_positions WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pilot_positions WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'OPEN' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_status_tracker WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status IN ('WHITE', 'GRAY', 'BLACK') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "파일럿_잔고" WHERE "종목" = #{symbol} AND "상태" = '보유' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "오토봇_잔고" WHERE "종목" = #{symbol} AND "상태" = '보유' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM panic_stop_events WHERE active = 'Y'

SELECT tracker.id, tracker.trading_history_master_id AS masterId, tracker.system_type AS systemType, tracker.symbol, tracker.market_currency AS marketCurrency, tracker.entry_price AS entryPrice, tracker.entry_quantity AS entryQuantity, tracker.entry_amount AS entryAmount, tracker.entry_time AS entryTime, tracker.status, tracker.status_entered_at AS statusEnteredAt, tracker.gray_entered_at AS grayEnteredAt, tracker.force_liquidation_flag AS forceLiquidationFlag, tracker.updated_at AS updatedAt, master.status AS masterStatus, master.sell_time AS masterSellTime, NULL AS lastPrice, NULL AS tradedAt FROM active_status_tracker tracker LEFT JOIN trading_history_master master ON master.id = tracker.trading_history_master_id WHERE tracker.status IN ('WHITE', 'GRAY', 'BLACK') AND ( tracker.trading_history_master_id IS NULL OR master.id IS NULL OR master.status != 'OPEN' OR master.sell_time IS NOT NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS id, master.id AS masterId, master.system_type AS systemType, master.symbol, master.market_currency AS marketCurrency, master.buy_price AS entryPrice, master.buy_quantity AS entryQuantity, master.buy_amount AS entryAmount, master.buy_time AS entryTime, 'MISSING_TRACKER' AS status, master.updated_at AS statusEnteredAt, NULL AS grayEnteredAt, master.force_liquidation_flag AS forceLiquidationFlag, master.updated_at AS updatedAt, master.status AS masterStatus, master.sell_time AS masterSellTime, NULL AS lastPrice, NULL AS tradedAt FROM trading_history_master master LEFT JOIN active_status_tracker tracker ON tracker.trading_history_master_id = master.id AND tracker.status IN ('WHITE', 'GRAY', 'BLACK') WHERE master.status = 'OPEN' AND tracker.id IS NULL ORDER BY systemType, symbol, masterId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO panic_stop_events ( reason, detail, alert_status, active, created_at ) VALUES ( #{reason}, #{detail}, 'ALERT_REQUIRED', 'Y', #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT market_currency FROM trading_history_master WHERE status = 'OPEN' UNION SELECT DISTINCT market_currency FROM active_status_tracker WHERE status IN ('WHITE', 'GRAY', 'BLACK')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_allocation_snapshots ( market_currency, total_wallet_balance, pilot_budget, autobot_budget, pilot_used_amount, autobot_used_amount, pilot_available_amount, autobot_available_amount, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{marketCurrency}, #{totalWalletBalance}, #{pilotBudget}, #{autobotBudget}, #{pilotUsedAmount}, #{autobotUsedAmount}, #{pilotAvailableAmount}, #{autobotAvailableAmount}, #{calculatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM positions WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND active = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND order_status IN ('REQUESTED', 'DRY_RUN', 'ACCEPTED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'RETRY_PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM positions WHERE active = 'Y'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(invested_amount AS REAL)), 0) FROM positions WHERE active = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('FAILED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( broker_order_id, stock_code, order_type, order_quantity, order_price, order_amount, order_status, retry_count, error_message, requested_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{brokerOrderId}, #{stockCode}, #{orderType}, #{orderQuantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderStatus}, 0, #{errorMessage}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_status FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( broker_order_id, stock_code, order_type, order_quantity, order_price, order_amount, order_status, retry_count, error_message, requested_at, updated_at, idempotency_key, decision_cycle_id, instance_id, masked_account, skip_reason, exit_reason, dry_run, current_price, current_price_at ) VALUES ( #{brokerOrderId}, #{stockCode}, #{orderType}, #{orderQuantity}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderStatus}, 0, #{errorMessage}, #{requestedAt}, #{requestedAt}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{decisionCycleId}, #{instanceId}, #{maskedAccount}, #{skipReason}, #{exitReason}, #{dryRun}, #{currentPrice}, #{currentPriceAt} )
INSERT INTO scheduler_execution ( scheduler_type, started_at, finished_at, execution_status, message ) VALUES ( #{schedulerType}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{executionStatus}, #{message} )
INSERT INTO audit_log ( event_type, stock_code, details, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{stockCode}, #{details}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO pilot_positions ( symbol, market_currency, quantity, invested_amount, average_entry_price, status, opened_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{quantity}, #{investedAmount}, #{averageEntryPrice}, #{status}, #{openedAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO pilot_order_intents ( symbol, market_currency, side, order_amount, order_quantity, reference_price, reason, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{side}, #{orderAmount}, #{orderQuantity}, #{referencePrice}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO pilot_observations ( symbol, market_currency, market_state, entry_pattern, position_status, survival_seconds, observed_at ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{marketState}, #{entryPattern}, #{positionStatus}, #{survivalSeconds}, #{observedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT grade FROM asset_grade_decisions WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY decided_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_grade_decisions ( symbol, grade, reason, decided_at ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{grade}, #{reason}, #{decidedAt} )

INSERT INTO autobot_order_intents ( symbol, market_currency, side, share_quantity, reference_price, asset_grade, reason, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{side}, #{shareQuantity}, #{referencePrice}, #{assetGrade}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO trading_history_master ( system_type, symbol, market_currency, buy_price, buy_quantity, buy_amount, buy_time, sell_price, sell_time, pnl_ratio, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{systemType}, #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{buyPrice}, #{buyQuantity}, #{buyAmount}, #{buyTime}, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'OPEN', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO active_status_tracker ( trading_history_master_id, system_type, symbol, market_currency, entry_price, entry_quantity, entry_amount, entry_time, status, status_entered_at, gray_entered_at, force_liquidation_flag, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{masterId}, #{systemType}, #{symbol}, #{marketCurrency}, #{entryPrice}, #{entryQuantity}, #{entryAmount}, #{entryTime}, 'WHITE', #{createdAt}, NULL, 'N', #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tracker.id, COALESCE(tracker.trading_history_master_id, master.id) AS masterId, tracker.system_type AS systemType, tracker.symbol, tracker.market_currency AS marketCurrency, tracker.entry_price AS entryPrice, tracker.entry_quantity AS entryQuantity, tracker.entry_amount AS entryAmount, tracker.entry_time AS entryTime, tracker.status, tracker.status_entered_at AS statusEnteredAt, tracker.gray_entered_at AS grayEnteredAt, tracker.force_liquidation_flag AS forceLiquidationFlag, tracker.updated_at AS updatedAt, master.status AS masterStatus, master.sell_time AS masterSellTime, ticks.last_price AS lastPrice, ticks.traded_at AS tradedAt FROM active_status_tracker tracker LEFT JOIN trading_history_master master ON master.id = COALESCE( tracker.trading_history_master_id, ( SELECT fallback.id FROM trading_history_master fallback WHERE fallback.system_type = tracker.system_type AND fallback.symbol = tracker.symbol AND fallback.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY fallback.buy_time ASC, fallback.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT t.symbol, t.last_price, t.traded_at FROM pilot_market_ticks t INNER JOIN ( SELECT symbol, MAX(id) AS id FROM pilot_market_ticks GROUP BY symbol ) latest ON latest.id = t.id ) ticks ON ticks.symbol = tracker.symbol WHERE tracker.status IN ('WHITE', 'GRAY', 'BLACK') ORDER BY tracker.system_type, tracker.symbol

SELECT tracker.id, COALESCE(tracker.trading_history_master_id, master.id) AS masterId, tracker.system_type AS systemType, tracker.symbol, tracker.market_currency AS marketCurrency, tracker.entry_price AS entryPrice, tracker.entry_quantity AS entryQuantity, tracker.entry_amount AS entryAmount, tracker.entry_time AS entryTime, tracker.status, tracker.status_entered_at AS statusEnteredAt, tracker.gray_entered_at AS grayEnteredAt, tracker.force_liquidation_flag AS forceLiquidationFlag, tracker.updated_at AS updatedAt, master.status AS masterStatus, master.sell_time AS masterSellTime, ticks.last_price AS lastPrice, ticks.traded_at AS tradedAt FROM active_status_tracker tracker LEFT JOIN trading_history_master master ON master.id = COALESCE( tracker.trading_history_master_id, ( SELECT fallback.id FROM trading_history_master fallback WHERE fallback.system_type = tracker.system_type AND fallback.symbol = tracker.symbol AND fallback.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY fallback.buy_time ASC, fallback.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT t.symbol, t.last_price, t.traded_at FROM pilot_market_ticks t INNER JOIN ( SELECT symbol, MAX(id) AS id FROM pilot_market_ticks GROUP BY symbol ) latest ON latest.id = t.id ) ticks ON ticks.symbol = tracker.symbol WHERE tracker.status = 'BLACK' ORDER BY tracker.system_type, tracker.symbol
mapper.update: UPDATE active_status_tracker SET status = #{status}, status_entered_at = #{statusEnteredAt}, gray_entered_at = #{grayEnteredAt}, force_liquidation_flag = #{forceLiquidationFlag}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_status_history_log ( tracker_id, master_id, system_type, symbol, previous_status, new_status, event_type, reason, force_liquidation_flag, logged_at ) VALUES ( #{trackerId}, #{masterId}, #{systemType}, #{symbol}, #{previousStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{eventType}, #{reason}, #{forceLiquidationFlag}, #{loggedAt} )

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trading_training_dataset ( master_id, system_type, symbol, market_currency, buy_price, buy_quantity, buy_amount, buy_time, sell_price, sell_time, pnl_ratio, force_liquidation_flag, outcome_status, created_at ) SELECT id, system_type, symbol, market_currency, buy_price, buy_quantity, buy_amount, buy_time, sell_price, sell_time, pnl_ratio, force_liquidation_flag, status, #{createdAt} FROM trading_history_master WHERE id = #{masterId} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND sell_price IS NOT NULL AND sell_time IS NOT NULL AND pnl_ratio IS NOT NULL
